text:
anya.prod: Quick sync — I'm drafting an onramp playbook for Private Deploy (VPC + on‑prem). Need to decide scope, launch gates, upgrade/rollback criteria, and handoff runbooks. Who can review today?

kai.eng-runtime: I can take packaging + upgrade path. Big risk items: airgap packaging size, kernel deps, and how we migrate KV cache during in‑place upgrades. Suggest 2 upgrade flows: minor (in‑place rolling) and major (blue/green with DB migration).

sarah.ops: Ops asks: add a mandatory "network validation" step that customers run before installer. It should verify egress to telemetry endpoints, NAT rules, and cert validation. Example check we can ship:```bash
# quick network check
curl -sfS https://telemetry.redwood.ai/ping || echo 'telemetry blocked'
nc -zv customer-egress-host 443 || echo 'egress port 443 blocked'
```

benj.solutions: Field feedback: customers expect zero-downtime rolling upgrades and a terraform module for VPC wiring. Also want example NGINX/LB L7 config, not just L4 snippets. Can we provide a "starter repo" for netops? :white_check_mark:

devon.security: Security gating: KMS/HSM integration must be validated in staged flow. Acceptance criteria: (1) keys can be rotated via our API without service restart, (2) audit logs show key usage, (3) installer rejects running with default creds. Add these to launch checklist. Also require threat model doc for onprem variants.

mark.csm: From CS: we need customer comms templates for both upgrade and rollback. Also a pre-launch checklist for the customer (IP ranges, service accounts, expected downtime window). Recommend 3 pilot customers for the pilot stage, with weekly check-ins.

anya.prod: Agree on pilot -> GA split. Proposal: Pilot = 3 customers, dedicated SE support, manual upgrade assist. GA = self-serve installer + documented SLA. Launch gates: security signoff, 2 successful pilot upgrades, installer network validation pass, runbooks in ops oncall.

kai.eng-runtime: For rollback criteria: define clear health signals and automated cutover if new version fails. Signals: >5% 5xxs OR latency p95 > 3x baseline OR failed sql migrations. Rollback action: auto‑revert to pinned image and send incident to #eng-oncall. We can script a rollback CLI:```bash
redwood-deploy rollback --env onprem --to-image sha:abcd1234
```

sarah.ops: Add a staging smoke step that runs after upgrade and before marking complete: 1) connectivity checks, 2) sample inference run, 3) metrics sanity. If any fail, do rollback. We'll add those checks to the installer hooks.

benj.solutions: On the terraform module: I'll spin up a minimal module with examples for AWS and GCP and a best-practices doc for route tables and NACLs. Will include an L7 example and a comment about private endpoints.

devon.security: Also call out compliance gating: SOC2 checklist + evidence artifacts required before GA (audit logs retention, KMS rotation policy, encryption at rest verified).

mark.csm: Runbook snippets I'd like in the doc: customer communication timeline, severity classification for upgrade incidents, and rollback email template. I'll draft and drop in the doc.

deploy-bot: New runbook created: "private-deploy-onramp-v1" (id: RB-4291). Link: https://playbooks.internal/runbooks/RB-4291

anya.prod: Awesome — action items: kai to own upgrade/rollback scripts + health signals (ETA 3 days), benj to build terraform starter and L7 examples (ETA 5 days), sarah to add network validation + installer hooks (ETA 4 days), devon to list compliance acceptance criteria (ETA 3 days), mark to draft customer comms and pilot plan (ETA 2 days). I'll collate into the onramp playbook and share a draft Monday.

sarah.ops: One more ops note — we need a simple network troubleshooting guide to hand to customers (common NAT / MTU issues). I'll add a one-pager.

kai.eng-runtime: I'll also add a verification step for KV cache compatibility and a migration utility if required.

anya.prod: Thanks all. If anyone can't meet these ETA's DM me. Otherwise I'll create a follow-up thread once the draft is in the doc. :rocket:
